interface.signature: getMaxRepetitions(s1: str, n1: int, s2: str, n2: int) -> int

preconditions.description: The length of s1 is at least 1 and at most 100.
The length of s2 is at least 1 and at most 100.
The value of n1 is at least 0 and at most 10^6.
The value of n2 is at least 1 and at most 10^6.

postconditions.description: The function returns the maximum integer M such that [S2,M] can be obtained from S1.
